description: Sprint 10/11 E2E test ACLs. Differentiated per-folder groups so security trimming returns different results per group. Paths are the src_key (object path relative to the S3 bucket root, e.g. 'testset/finance/reports') and are mode-independent: the same keys apply whether files are read via the OneLake shortcut (source_mode=s3_shortcut) or directly from S3 (source_mode=s3_direct). Resolution is nearest-ancestor: a subfolder entry overrides its parent. engineering/* is intentionally omitted to exercise the no_acl skip path. Group GUIDs are placeholders for Entra group object IDs the calling app injects per user. See PRODUCT_SPEC.md section 10 and the Sprint 10 E2E section.
